svg.text: Front, three-quarter right, three-quarter left, back. Pale designed dome with an open temple arc, swept-back teal hair, dark tunic, light belt and knot. Working labels, placeholder design, pending Legal review.
Body 99 units to the top of the head, head 18.1 units: about 5.5 heads tall
Build: round, open, forward-leaning. Torso 1.0 of the standard height and 1.1 wide,
Staging: three-quarter in play, mirrored when the fighter faces left, so the left
view is the right view mirrored. The front and back are for modelling and are not
The value rule: dark tunic, light gear and mask. Tunic #1a3d46, gear #c4ece6, mask
#e8f1ee, hair #3fae9c, accent #4fb9a8. Hair never changes colour.
The mask is a designed dome: a faceted crown, a brow ridge, a jaw plane and a crown
seam. No eye or mouth slots or dots. The sigil is a single open arc (a "C" with a
gap facing forward), off-centre at the temple above the brow ridge: never a closed
ring, no dot, never with the slash. Hurt widens the gap.
Front features (belt, buckle, collar trim, sash apron) sit on the front surface.
Back features (knot, sash tails, apron) sit on the back surface. The back knot is
Legal conditions kept: the hair is a swept-back cap, never spiky or upswept, and
never gold; no red or gold glow; the heat (Hot Blood) is steam and veins on the
Read at play sizes: 80, 40, 24 and 12 px, in full colour and as a silhouette
Wear: fresh, bruised, battered, broken (three-quarter, upright)
The mask: neutral, taunt, hurt, rage, triumph (three-quarter), and the back of the head
Part list for the model (near LOD, about 1,600 triangles against the 2,500 budget)
A designed dome with brow ridge, jaw plane and crown seam. A sigil decal slot (an open arc, off-centre). No face rig.
A swept-back cap and a rounded tuft on a 3-bone spring chain. Never changes colour or shape.
A sleeveless dark tunic with a light collar trim.
A wide light belt, a solid disc knot at the back and two sash tails on a 2-bone spring chain each.
A light cloth panel to the hip, front and back.
Bare upper arm and forearm each.
Tone-on-tone wraps with a diagonal edge on the near forearm, toggled by stage. Not contrasting wristbands.
Wrapped fists. Open variants for taunt and guard.
Bones, about 26: root, pelvis, two spine, neck, head, three hair tuft (spring), two sash
tails of two (spring), two shoulders, upper arms, forearms, hands, thighs, shins, feet.
Palette masks: red channel tunic, green gear, blue accent, alpha the emissive sigil (the
arc). Wear is five floats (head, core, arms, legs, crown). Steam and veins are separate
